# SpaceAutoBattler

> Lightweight research-oriented 3D space combat simulator that separates deterministic simulation logic from rendering and UI. Use this file as a concise map for models and humans to find core docs, specs, sample code, and configuration.

Last updated: 2025-09-27

This file focuses on sources that explain the project's purpose, architecture, simulation contracts, configuration, and tests. Prefer the `src/` and `spec/` paths for implementation and formal specifications respectively.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Project overview, quick start, scripts, deployment notes, and contributing rules.
- [Copilot-Processing](Copilot-Processing.md): Agent processing notes and workflow guidance for contributors and bots.
- [Developer source layout](spec/src-structure.md): Developer-facing map of `src/` entry points and conventions.
- [Motion system spec](spec/spec-physical-movement.md): Deterministic ship movement, renderer interpolation, and simulation expectations.
- [AI overview and rollout](docs/ai-v2-overview.md): High-level AI design and rollout notes used by the project.
- [Configuration parameters](docs/CONFIG_PARAMETERS.md): Catalog of tunable parameters and their meanings.

## Specifications

- [Requirements](requirements.md): Top-level repository requirements and acceptance criteria.
- [Spec directory](spec/): All formal specifications and design documents (see individual files like `spec/spec-physical-movement.md`).
- [AGENTS guide](AGENTS.md): Repository guidelines, coding patterns, and agent integration notes.

## Examples & Entry Points

- [App bootstrap](src/main.tsx): Application bootstrap and renderer mounting example.
- [Top-level App](src/App.tsx): Minimal application usage and UI composition.
- [UI template](src/ui.html): Minimal static UI template / preview harness.
- [Sample scripts](scripts/): Utility and generation scripts used by the project (e.g., smoke tests, asset generation).

## Source & Core Libraries

- [Game logic (pure)](src/game/): Deterministic simulation logic, systems, and ship blueprints — safe to run headless.
- [Rendering components](src/components/): React / R3F components (Ship, Projectile, HUD).
- [Types (canonical)](src/types/index.ts): Single source of truth for runtime state (`GameState`) and shared interfaces.
- [Seeded RNG utility](src/utils/rng.ts): Deterministic RNG used across simulation codepaths.

## Configuration & Tooling

- [package.json](package.json): Scripts, dependencies, and common commands.
- [TypeScript config](tsconfig.json): Compiler options and path layout.
- [Webpack config](webpack.config.mjs): Build pipeline for dev and production bundles.
- [Playwright config](playwright.config.cjs): End-to-end test configuration and runners.
- [Vitest config](vitest.config.js): Unit test runner configuration.
- [ESLint config](eslint.config.ts) / [Prettier config](prettier.config.cjs): Linting and formatting rules.

## Tests & CI

- [Unit tests (Vitest)](test/vitest/): Deterministic logic tests and helpers.
- [E2E tests (Playwright)](test/playwright/): End-to-end UI flows and accessibility checks.
- [Test artifacts](test-output/): Playwright captures, reports, and test outputs.
- [Coverage reports](coverage/): Test coverage artifacts and HTML reports.
